# Copilot Instructions for resonagraph

## About This Project
resonagraph is a project focused on resonance and graph-based computations.

## Code Style and Standards
- Follow consistent naming conventions throughout the codebase
- Write clear, descriptive comments for complex logic
- Keep functions focused and modular
- Use meaningful variable and function names

## Testing Guidelines
- Write tests for new features and bug fixes
- Ensure all tests pass before committing code
- Maintain high test coverage for critical functionality

## Documentation
- Update README.md when adding new features or changing functionality
- Document public APIs and complex algorithms
- Keep documentation in sync with code changes

## Contribution Workflow
- Make small, focused commits with clear commit messages
- Follow the existing project structure and patterns
- Review and test changes locally before pushing

## Best Practices
- Prefer simple, readable code over clever optimizations
- Handle errors gracefully with appropriate error messages
- Consider performance implications for graph operations
- Maintain backward compatibility when possible
